subject: New website with documentation and a video presentation

messages.author: 3b104dc6686d0c85
messages.subject: New website with documentation and a video presentation
parts:
Dear group members,

in case you missed it: we have launched a new website for Renjin at http://www.renjin.org and we are working on converting and updating the documentation from the Google Project site. Be sure to check it out!

As part of our work towards the new 0.7.0 release, we've been putting a lot of effort in the package repository which you can find at http://packages.renjin.org. Here you can see the build status of all CRAN packages for Renjin.

Finally, Alex recently gave a presentation on Renjin at useR!2013, the annual user conference for the R programming language, which was held July 9-12 in Spain. The video of his presentation is now available online at http://www.renjin.org/blog/2013-07-21-alex-bertram-presents-renjin-at-the-r-user-conference-video.html

Maarten-Jan
